info.name: Denon LC6000 Prime Display
info.author: schmic
info.description: Display-only Mixxx mapping for the Denon LC6000 Prime WD port. Mirrors deck state to the center display using a second preset alongside the PR control mapping.

option.label: Deck assignment
option.description: Select which Mixxx deck this LC6000 display should follow. Use the same value as on the PR control mapping.

option.label: Deck color
option.description: Color accent for the display overlays. Use the same value as on the PR control mapping unless you are testing alternate themes.

option.label: Screen brightness
option.description: Brightness for the LC6000 center display on the WD port.
